description: This file defines the core data structures and functions for managing devices in an Android Cuttlefish frontend environment, including device registration, connection handling, proxy setup, and device pool management.

classes.name: Device
classes.description: Represents a device with connection and proxy management, client registration, and descriptor info.

classes.name: preDevice
classes.description: Holds information about a device during pre-registration phase.

classes.name: DevicePool
classes.description: Manages collections of pre-registered and registered devices, allowing registration, deregistration, and querying.

methods.name: newDevice
methods.description: Creates a new Device instance with a generated reverse proxy connected to a local address.

methods.name: Send
methods.description: Sends a message to the device connection.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a client with the device and returns a client ID.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a client from the device.

methods.name: DisconnectClients
methods.description: Instructs all registered clients that the device has disconnected.

methods.name: ToClient
methods.description: Sends a message to a specific client connected to the device.

methods.name: NewDevicePool
methods.description: Initializes a new device pool managing pre-registration and registration.

methods.name: PreRegister
methods.description: Pre-registers a device with given descriptor, allowing for forthcoming registration.

methods.name: CancelPreRegistration
methods.description: Cancels the pre-registration of a device by ID.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Completes registration of a device, creating a Device object if registration is successful.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Removes a device from the pool, disconnecting its clients.

methods.name: GetDevice
methods.description: Retrieves a registered device by ID.

methods.name: GroupIds
methods.description: Lists all device group IDs currently registered.

methods.name: DeviceIds
methods.description: Lists all device IDs currently registered.

methods.name: GetDeviceDescList
methods.description: Returns a list of descriptors for all registered devices.

methods.name: GetDeviceDescByGroupId
methods.description: Returns device descriptors filtered by a specific group ID.
